spec_match.rationale: Six failure paths map one-to-one onto spec steps: non-object receiver TypeError, Symbol separator/element TypeError, element-ToString abrupt closing (generator finally), separator-ToString abrupt closing (return() spy — a finally probe cannot see a close of a never-started generator, which the page teaches explicitly), and consumption; all six verified to match real V8 15.0 behavior.

interactive.rationale: One run-all action executes all six instrumented cases live and renders observed results plus a spec-vs-observed verdict per row; nothing in the table is prewritten output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the failure contract with finally-flag and return()-spy instrumentation, matching the page.

edge_cases.rationale: This concept IS the edge-case portfolio slot: it covers receiver, separator, element, closing, and consumption failures, including the unstarted-generator instrumentation trap.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5095183554314240, the spec steps, and the test262 PR that pins the contract.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite mirrors every case here (non-object-receiver-throws, symbol-separator-throws, join-consumes-iterator, element-tostring-abrupt-closes-iterator, separator-tostring-abrupt-closes-iterator), each written so it can return false on non-implementing browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP after the final edit (page-driver join-edges, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): 6 of 6 rows report matches-spec in the labelled model path, including 'return() called on the iterator: true' for case 5 and 'generator finally ran: true' for cases 3-4; zero console errors. The same six behaviors verified against the native method on V8 15.0 via deno --v8-flags=--js-iterator-join (sep-close.mjs: return() called true, started-generator finally true). Screenshots: join-edges.png (desktop), m-edges.png (mobile 360 post-interaction).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts join-edge-lab-core-contract (passCount === 6) with native/model detail after the run, plus the shared banner-honesty assert; expected TypeErrors are caught, so the console stays clean.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; verdict colours accent-emerald/accent-rose on bg-paper (AA); the instrumentation note uses bg-stone with charcoal text and a rose border; buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Case names are row-scoped th elements in a captioned table; the run button is native with visible focus; the results summary is role=status; the scrollable table wrapper is focusable with an explanatory aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 with the four-column table wrapping via overflow-wrap:anywhere inside its scroll container; verified visually in m-edges.png post-interaction; responsive-check for the feature reports mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Track whether test262 lands an observable-close test for the separator-ToString path
openQuestions.detail: Case 5's contract (IfAbruptCloseIterator before iteration starts) is demonstrated with a return()-spy and passes on V8 15.0. When the test262 suite from PR #4768 is merged and surfaced in WPT runs, confirm the upstream test uses the same observable and link it from the page's see-also section.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Data tables need caption and th scoping (including scope=row for case-named rows); dynamic summaries belong in status live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each case name is a th scope=row; the table has a caption describing spec-vs-observed; the pass-count summary is role=status and updates after each run.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep wide tabular content inside its own overflow container and let long tokens wrap so the page body never scrolls horizontally.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Four-column results table sits in .table-wrap with overflow-x:auto, cells use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified scrollWidth 360 on mobile emulation.

summary: Edge/failure angle: six live failure paths with correct instrumentation for each (generator finally where iteration started, return() spy where it had not), teaching a real observability gotcha that initially fooled this build — an unstarted generator's finally never runs even though join does close the iterator. All six paths verified against both the labelled spec-model (Chromium 141) and the native implementation (V8 15.0 in Deno).
